focus.name: player-position-response-family
focus.purpose: Promote the Type-0x5E actor-position adoption path and Type-0x01 proximity-bounce path to behavior-based canonical names.

type5e: requires terrain response to be inactive or vertically stopped and actor collision flag bit 0x10
copies actor X/Y minus WORLD_CAMERA_X/Y into PLAYER_X/Y
clears TERRAIN_HORIZONTAL_RESPONSE and restores camera thresholds to 0x00B0/0x0170
restarts PLAYER_ANIM_INTERACTION_RESPONSE_LOOP when TERRAIN_RESPONSE_TIMER_STATE is nonzero, otherwise raises PLAYER_COLLISION_RESPONSE_SUPPRESS
type01: requires non-upward PLAYER_VY and a clear PLAYER_INTERACTION_ANIMATION_GATE
requires vertical separation no greater than five pixels
writes PLAYER_VY=-0x0800 and PLAYER_Y from actor Y minus WORLD_CAMERA_Y
converts the source actor to Type 0x84 and derives signed PLAYER_VX from world-X separation
